about: CM4a in a real window: a synthetic sketch dropped on the Agent column and sent. Run only with the debug-bridge agent-images-acceptance example: a throwaway tiny seed library, synthetic keys in memory, one loopback service standing in for Anthropic (its model list says the model takes images; its Messages endpoint answers with the size of each image a request carried, with a thinking block only when an image arrived) and DeepSeek (whose list says nothing about images). No real provider, key or model. The accessibility tree has no plain text: the answers themselves are read on the screenshots.

steps.note: The right column has finished sliding open: a drop lands where the column is drawn, unlike a press, which rests first.

steps.note: Anthropic's live list was asked and the request carried the image: only then does the loopback answer with a thinking block (and the line 「收到 1 张图片：640×400」, on 02-sent.png).
